ValidUntil.description: This exchange rate is valid until the next run of the scheduled batch to get new exchange rate details. ISO 8601 DateTime.

Currency.description:
A code allocated to a currency by a Maintenance Agency under
an international identification scheme, as described in the latest edition
of the international standard ISO 4217 "Codes for the representation of
currencies and funds".

UnitCurrency.description: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange.

ExchangeRate.description:
The factor used for conversion of an amount from one currency
to another. This reflects the price at which one currency was bought with
another currency. Rate expressed as a decimal, for example, 0.7 is 7/10
and 70%.

RateType.description:
Specifies the type used to complete the currency exchange.
* Spot: Exchange rate applied is the spot rate.

SourceCurrencyReferenceId.description: This should be used to refer to this exchange rate details for currency conversion from the new exchange rate table.

TargetCurrencyReferenceId.description: This should be used to reference the second entry ID in the exchange rate table row when cross-currency conversion is required, and two entries are selected for calculation.
